configurations.name: Media Finder: Full system
configurations.command: zsh -lc 'umask 077; if [[ -r "${env:HOME}/.media-finder-integrations.env" ]]; then set -a; source "${env:HOME}/.media-finder-integrations.env"; set +a; else print -u2 "Integration environment file not found; external modules will be unavailable."; fi; export MEDIA_FINDER_DATABASE_URL="sqlite:///${workspaceFolder}/media-finder-local.db"; export MEDIA_FINDER_UI_SECRET="$(openssl rand -hex 32)"; export MEDIA_FINDER_INTEGRATION_TOKEN="$(openssl rand -hex 32)"; export MEDIA_FINDER_SECURE_COOKIE=false; export MEDIA_FINDER_UI_MODE=builtin; export MEDIA_FINDER_LOG_LEVEL=debug; pnpm ui:build && exec uv run python -c "from media_finder_server.runtime import configure_logging, core_configuration, create_application, migrate_to_head; import uvicorn; configuration = core_configuration(); configure_logging(configuration.log_level); migrate_to_head(configuration.database_url); uvicorn.run(create_application(), host=\"0.0.0.0\", port=8000, workers=1, proxy_headers=True, log_level=configuration.log_level)"'

configurations.name: Media Finder: UI with mock API
Media Finder: Full verification
configurations.command: zsh -lc 'set -euo pipefail; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; uv sync --frozen --all-groups; pnpm docs:check; pnpm spec:validate; pnpm delivery:test; pnpm delivery:validate; pnpm module-conformance:test; pnpm module-conformance:validate; uv run ruff format --check .; uv run ruff check .; uv run mypy; pnpm ui:format; pnpm ui:lint; pnpm ui:type; pnpm ui:contract; pnpm ui:test; pnpm ui:a11y; uv run python packages/builtin-ui/tests/run_isolated.py unit; uv run pytest; uv run python scripts/check_schema_drift.py; pnpm ui:browser; pnpm ui:build; for launch_package in media-finder media-finder-core media-finder-module-sdk media-finder-control-contracts media-finder-builtin-ui media-finder-metadata-manual media-finder-metadata-tmdb media-finder-release-prowlarr media-finder-download-qbittorrent; do uv build --wheel --package "$launch_package" --out-dir dist/wheels; done; uv run pytest tests/test_wheel_isolation.py tests/test_workspace_packages.py tests/architecture/test_package_boundaries.py tests/architecture/test_legacy_root_removal.py; git diff --exit-code -- packages/builtin-ui/src/media_finder_builtin_ui/static; sg docker -c "docker build --tag media-finder:ci . && bash scripts/smoke-container.sh"'
